description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-E (%) performance of different LLaMA-2 model scales under various Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) dataset conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categories, representing the model scales ordered from smallest to largest: "LLaMA-2-7B", "LLaMA-2-13B", and "LLaMA-2-70B". The vertical axis is a linear value axis labeled "CoLeG-E (%)", ranging from 0 to 50 with a tick label interval of 10. The chart features grouped bars, with four bars in each group corresponding to different SFT conditions as indicated by the legend: "no SFT" (solid light blue), "+ SFT on $D_0$" (solid light orange), "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" (light purple with diagonal hatching), and "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" (solid light pink). Within each model category, the bar heights consistently increase across the four conditions from left to right. For LLaMA-2-7B, values range from approximately 5% for "no SFT" to 30% for "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$". For LLaMA-2-13B, values range from roughly 10% to 40%. For LLaMA-2-70B, values range from about 23% to 48%. The shortest bar overall is the "no SFT" condition for LLaMA-2-7B at approximately 5%, while the tallest bar is the "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" condition for LLaMA-2-70B at approximately 48%. The groups are sorted horizontally by increasing model size, and the bars within each group are ordered by the cumulative addition of SFT datasets. The "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" bars are visually distinguished from the others by their hatched pattern.
